init_hook: rustup target list --installed --toolchain "$RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN" 2>/dev/null | grep -x wasm32-wasip1 >/dev/null || rustup toolchain install "$RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN" --profile minimal --target wasm32-wasip1 || echo "Rust $RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN could not be installed: see the error above. Everything else here works, but Rust actions will not build until a later start installs it." >&2
